fine_lines.title: me vs myself
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم myself عندما يكون الفاعل والمفعول به نفس الشخص: I asked myself. ونستخدم me عندما يكون المفعول به شخصًا آخر غير الفاعل: She asked me.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use myself when the subject and object are the same person: I asked myself. Use me when someone else is the subject: She asked me.

examples.sentence: I asked myself the same question.
Ms. Weaver asked me a question.

fine_lines.title: -self vs -selves
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الضمائر المفردة تنتهي بـ self: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself. والجمع ينتهي بـ selves: ourselves, yourselves, themselves.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Singular reflexive pronouns end in -self: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself. Plural ones end in -selves: ourselves, yourselves, themselves.

examples.sentence: Anna, help yourself to a cookie.
Anna and Pete, you must do it by yourselves.

fine_lines.title: flour vs flower

fine_lines.explanation_en: They sound the same. Flour is for baking; a flower is a plant.

grammar.title: Reflexive pronouns
grammar.explanation_ar: الضمائر الانعكاسية تعود على الفاعل، ونستخدمها عندما يكون الفاعل والمفعول به نفس الشخص أو الشيء. الضمائر: I → myself، you → yourself، he → himself، she → herself، it → itself، we → ourselves، you (جمع) → yourselves، they → themselves. المفرد ينتهي بـ self والجمع بـ selves. ونستخدم by + الضمير الانعكاسي بمعنى «وحدك / بدون مساعدة»: by yourselves.
grammar.explanation_en: Reflexive pronouns refer back to the subject. Use them when the subject and object are the same: I → myself, you → yourself, he → himself, she → herself, it → itself, we → ourselves, you (plural) → yourselves, they → themselves. Singular ones end in -self, plural ones in -selves. By + reflexive pronoun means alone, without help.
examples: I asked myself the same question.
A baby cannot take care of itself.
You two must do everything by yourselves.
We need to throw ourselves into the research!

questions.explanation_en: Subject and object are the same: herself.

questions.explanation_en: The baby is 'it' here, so: itself.
